purpose: Single fully-specified pipeline applied IDENTICALLY across all cohorts for honest cross-cohort replication.

expression_handling.scRNA: pseudobulk sum UMI per patient x phase -> CPM -> log2(CPM+1) -> mean over pathway genes
expression_handling.bulk: start from provided TPM/normalized -> log2(x+1) -> z-score genes across samples WITHIN cohort -> mean over pathway genes
expression_handling.cross_cohort: each cohort analyzed independently; NO raw-value cross-cohort merging; meta-summary is vote-count / fixed-effect on effect sizes

resistance_label_rule.categorical_fallback: use provided sensitive/resistant labels where PFI absent (state definition)
resistance_label_rule.discovery_labels: repo corrected resistance_labels.json (7R/4S, EOC227 sensitive) canonical; manuscript 8R/3S shown side-by-side

statistics.continuous_primary: Spearman rho (post-treatment pathway score vs PFI), label-independent
statistics.binary: AUROC (resistant vs sensitive), 95% CI via 2000-iter bootstrap, Wilcoxon rank-sum p
statistics.paired: delta (post-pre) vs absolute post-treatment state, to test delta-null out-of-sample
statistics.survival: KM median-split + log-rank, disclosed as in-sample exploratory
statistics.multiplicity: BH-FDR across primary test family per cohort
statistics.adequacy: report EPV per cohort; flag EPV<10; NO cross-validated multivariate ML (insufficient events)

success_criterion: signal replicated if post-treatment-state -> resistance holds SAME DIRECTION with frozen pipeline in >=2 independent cohorts beyond BriTROC-1, with effect sizes+CIs; non-replication reported honestly.
tiering: RUO / hypothesis-generating; no clinical or regulatory claim.
